arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Bryan Stevenson argued for Nelson. He stated no state remedy exists for Nelson. He rejected the state claim that state options remain open.
Donal Campbell argued for the state. He claimed Nelson can still seek a new death warrant. He noted the previous warrant expired after a stay.
